jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one complete wide 2D fighting-game stage background for CQC Versus Legacy, an adaptation of Metal Gear Solid 2 Big Shell Strut F Warehouse. The supplied image is ONLY the established project's painting/pixel-texture, material and lighting reference, not the room to copy. Draw the warehouse itself, not the dining hall: a tall closed two-level industrial storage interior, muted green steel walls, pale cold fluorescent ceiling lights, grey metal floor, upper perimeter catwalk with green handrails around a central void, staircases at far sides, storage doors and substantial orderly olive green metal supply crates against the rear walls. Subtle orange-red structural struts. Wide front-facing lateral camera at a fighting game height, very shallow perspective, level horizontal floor, straight architecture. Floor contact line across the image at about 80% from top, visible floor down to bottom. Keep lower-center 60% of the composition unobstructed for two large fighters; upper catwalk belongs to background only. Polished crisp detailed shaded sprite-game art, intricate small rivets and worn metal, no blurry concept painting. One continuous scene, no panels or atlas, no characters, no text, no HUD, no floating weapons, no cinematographic letterboxing. Do not include kitchen, dining tables, windows out to sea, shipping cranes or unrelated futuristic machinery. Preserve the reference palette and material quality.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE separate transparent scenery prop for CQC Versus Legacy's Metal Gear Solid 2 Big Shell Strut F Warehouse adaptation. The supplied image is ONLY the project's crisp painted pixel-game material and palette reference. Draw one closed low rectangular olive green steel military storage crate, horizontal box wider than tall, reinforced ribbed panels, recessed handles at the two short ends, small steel corner guards and two closed front latches. Shallow side-front three-quarter view compatible with a lateral 2D fighting game; top surface visible only slightly. Muted desaturated sage/olive paint and dark grey metal with wear at corners; neutral diffuse fluorescent top light, detailed sharp sprite texture matching reference. Crate fully in frame with comfortable transparent margins, no ground plane, no cast shadow on background, no surroundings, no person or weapon, no extra lid/object, no labels or text. Exactly one coherent complete prop. Real transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE separate transparent foreground railing for CQC Versus Legacy's Metal Gear Solid 2 Big Shell Strut F Warehouse adaptation. Use supplied image ONLY for established painted pixel-game material shading style and muted industrial palette. A single complete horizontal two-post safety guardrail section, two dark green vertical steel posts with small rectangular mounting feet connected by one top horizontal bar and one mid-height horizontal bar, slender squared industrial metal profiles, desaturated grey-green chipped paint and worn edges. True front side view for a 2D fighting game, horizontal level bars; short wide composition around 3:1, all posts and feet fully visible with transparent margins. High quality detailed sharp sprite-game art, neutral overhead fluorescent lighting. No attached floor, wall, stairs, humans, chains, text, symbols or extra railing section. One cohesive prop only, genuine transparent background including every open space between bars.
